description: Deprecated alias of search_grantsplus with a queries array.

detail_level.description: Response detail per result. minimal (about 120 bytes per result): id, title, org, deadline, url, qualityScore. compact (default, about 400 bytes per result): adds snippet, category, status, deadlineType, daysUntilDeadline, deadlineLabel and lastRoundClosedAt. full (about 1.5KB per result): everything, including eligibility and amounts.

max_response_tokens.description: Token budget for the response (default: 4000, about 16KB; minimum 500). The server caps the number of results to fit the budget.

max_results.description: Maximum opportunities to return (default: 10, max: 100). Token cost guide: 10 results ~4KB, 25 results ~10KB, 50 results ~20KB, 100 results ~40KB.

new_within_days.description: Older name for posted_within_days, kept for compatibility: only opportunities FundingLandscape added in the last N days. Applied to each query before merging; the response includes newSince.newCount and the newest and oldest added times.

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination (default: 0). Together with max_results it pages through large result sets: offset=100 with max_results=100 returns results 101-200.

posted_within_days.description: Only opportunities FundingLandscape added in the last N days, by the date added. Applied to each query before merging; the response includes a merged newSince summary. Same as new_within_days; when both are set, this value applies.

queries.description: Array of 1 to 5 search queries run together. Example for clean energy: ["renewable energy grants", "solar wind funding", "clean energy nonprofit", "sustainability grants", "green technology funding"]

since.description: Stateless alternative to posted_within_days/new_within_days: ISO 8601 instant. Only opportunities ingested at/after this instant.

source.description: Source domain applied to every query, e.g. "grants.gov" or "deq.nc.gov".

organization_type.description: Common natural-language phrasing (e.g. "501(c)(3) nonprofit") is also parsed; unparseable values are ignored with an explicit note in the response. A tribal government fits government and a tribal nonprofit fits nonprofit.

name: batch_search_grantsplus
title: Batch Search Grants
